card.title: Relationship Ledger
card.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll let the argument go if you come to my opening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought forgiveness was a gift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It is. I'd like to hand it over beside my paintings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm working that night. I could help hang them on Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hanging buys forgiveness. Stay to take them down and I'll stop mentioning the argument to Mum.

mechanism: A prices forgiveness and silence about the grievance in exhibition labor and continued presence.
confusable: Unlike accepting help as a gesture of goodwill, A must explicitly assign emotional concessions to particular services.
comparison: D94-a trades hanging and teardown for different levels of forgiveness; D94-b trades meals and shared listening for access and carrying support.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
